name: Pepper Chicken Fettucini
description: A colorful and flavorful chicken fettucini dish with sweet peppers, mushrooms, and Parmesan cheese.
recipeIngredient: 2 sweet red peppers, cut in strips

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a pan. Add chicken, peppers, onion, mushrooms, and seasoning. Stir-fry over medium heat until chicken is cooked through.
Add hot cooked fettucini noodles and toss.
Sprinkle with Parmesan and toss. Serve hot.

_similar.name: Parmesan Chicken
_similar.description: A crispy Parmesan-crusted chicken dish baked with spaghetti sauce and mozzarella cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix Parmesan cheese with bread crumbs and set aside.
Mix eggs, salt, and pepper.
Dip boneless chicken breasts in egg mixture, then coat with bread crumb mixture.
Arrange coated chicken breasts in a baking dish.
Cover with tinfoil and bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.
Pour spaghetti sauce over the chicken and continue baking.
Before serving, sprinkle grated mozzarella cheese on top and bake for an additional 10 minutes until browned.

_similar.keywords: Parmesan chicken, breaded chicken, Italian-American cuisine

_similar.name: Chicken and Broccoli
_similar.description: A creamy chicken and broccoli pasta bake with Parmesan cheese and mushroom soup.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the small shells pasta according to package directions. Drain.
Add cooked broccoli, chopped chicken, cream of mushroom soup, milk, Parmesan cheese, and ground pepper to the cooked pasta.
Boil the mixture for 2 minutes to heat through and combine the sauce.
Serve hot with a cranberry salad.

_similar.keywords: chicken and broccoli, pasta bake, creamy chicken

_similar.name: Chicken Supreme
_similar.description: A hearty chicken dish with tomatoes, herbs, and cheese, baked to perfection and served over rice or pasta.

recipeInstructions.text: Boil the chicken breasts in a separate container until pink is gone (about 1/4 of the way cooked).
In a baking or roasting pan, mix together the tomato ingredients (stewed tomatoes, green pepper, onion, basil, oregano, garlic).
Place the partially cooked chicken breasts in the bottom of the pan.
Sprinkle spices over the chicken breasts.
Pour the remaining tomato mixture on top of the chicken breasts.
Cover and bake at 350°F for approximately ½ hour.
Sprinkle grated cheese on top, cover, and bake for an additional 15 minutes.
Serve over rice or pasta.

_similar.keywords: chicken supreme, baked chicken, Italian-style chicken

_similar.name: Thai Chicken
_similar.description: A Thai-inspired chicken dish with spaghetti, vegetables, and a tangy sauce, served hot or chilled.
recipeIngredient: 2 tsp Sambal Oelek or hot pepper sauce

recipeInstructions.text: Cook pasta according to package directions for the minimum time. Drain, rinse with cold water, and drain again.
Stir pasta in a large bowl to coat with sesame oil.
Finely grate the peel from 1 lime and squeeze juice to measure 1/4 cup. Stir juice, peel, soya sauce, hot pepper sauce, salt, and sugar into pasta.
Slice chicken into bite-size pieces, thinly slice pepper, onion, and celery, and julienne carrots.
Stir-fry chicken in batches and return to the pan with garlic and onions. Stir-fry about 3 minutes.
Stir in water, peppers, celery, and carrots. Continue stirring about 3 minutes, adding a bit more water if necessary.
Add snow peas and stir about 1 minute.
Toss with the pasta, serve right away, or chill overnight and serve cold the next day.

_similar.name: Pizza Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty pizza-inspired casserole with pasta, pepperoni, and mozzarella cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Melt margarine and sauté chopped onion until soft.
Add tomato sauce, mushrooms, oregano, and basil. Stir and remove from heat.
Cook pasta in boiling water with oil and salt for 8 to 10 minutes until tender but firm. Drain.
Combine cooked pasta with Parmesan cheese and 1 cup mozzarella cheese in a 3-quart casserole.
Scatter pepperoni slices over the pasta mixture.
Cover with the tomato-onion sauce and sprinkle with remaining mozzarella cheese.
Bake, uncovered, in a 350°F oven for 30 minutes.

_similar.keywords: pizza casserole, pasta bake, pepperoni, mozzarella cheese
